second_order: Playing with and pushing back on the subreddit makeover
theme_note: Participants make, invoke, endure, work around, and debate the room's own April Fools presentation changes; what varies is whether they request the joke, perform it through the moderator persona and routine threads, complain about usability, or ask to retain it.

second_order: Getting a keyboard mark onto r/place
theme_note: Participants propose a keyboard or switch mark, interpret what 'place' means, recover from erasure, ask for a plan, circulate coordinates and templates, commit pixels, and publicly recruit or celebrate construction; what varies is how tentative or organised the attempt is.

second_order: Maintaining, recolouring, and negotiating around the canvas mark
theme_note: Participants manage an existing or emerging mark against overlap, recolouring, takeover, expansion, and neighbouring claims; what varies is whether they warn, defend, redirect alterations, dispute credit, seek compromise, or promise reciprocal maintenance.

second_order: Making and unpacking keyboard April Fools claims
theme_note: Participants stage keyboard products, announcements, pranks, and inverted routines as plausible, then play along with, desire, doubt, recognise, or reveal them; what varies is the object and whether the joke fools, irritates, or attracts its audience.

second_order: Turning the S-Puck prank into a build
theme_note: Participants explicitly recall the S-Puck gag and try to make it real through measurements, materials, fabrication plans, cases, prototypes, uses, and learning motives; what varies is the technical contribution and degree of commitment, while completion remains unseen.

A title names r/place, but deletion removes the post's practice and no reply restores it; this single-code theme is kept separate because it belongs with no observable doing beyond making the opaque mention.

second_order: Displaying, crediting, and explaining the finished canvas mark
theme_note: Participants show the surviving representation, credit and cheer its makers, recall defence and alliance help, contest repeated event posts, identify the image, and explain r/place to newcomers; what varies is celebration, retrospective labour, resistance, and explanation.
